monte_carlo.what: 2000 redraws of every stored predicted curve (binomial, 200000 shots per point), refitted (WL); the observations fixed. sd is the Monte Carlo spread a fresh simulation would give the chi2; the mean also carries the redraw's added noise.

windows.what: plain means over the days of Lambda_X = eps3 / eps5, device and model (the prediction at the measured f, 200,000 shots), each curve fitted on the window

power.what: power of chi2 = sum z^2 > 18.31 against the same miss in every repetition, noncentral chi2 with 10 dof at each repetition's sigma = sqrt(sigma_O^2 + sigma_M^2)

provenance.inputs of power.json: the frozen f = 0 and f = 1 predictions (prediction.json) of all fifteen jobs; days 2-5's were made on their own days
provenance.assumes: f known exactly (no f term) and sigma_O at the predicted curves

scatter_power.what: the exploratory test's chi2 over ten repetitions, sigma'^2 = sigma^2 + (s_Q M)^2
